label: HT814 4-port FXS ATA
description: Analog telephone adapter with 4 RJ-11 FXS ports driven by 2 SIP profiles, sitting behind an integrated gigabit NAT router fed by two 10/100/1000 RJ-45 ports wired as a WAN/LAN pair.
notes: Datasheet interfaces: four (4) RJ-11 FXS ports, two (2) 10/100/1000 Mbps RJ-45 ports. The four FXS lines are analog telephony and are not modelled as interfaces; only the WAN/LAN pair is. The LAN side is a switched NAT router, hence dhcp-server/nat/firewall on top of the voice stack. T.38 fax relay, G.711/G.722/G.723.1/G.729A/B/G.726-32, TLS/SRTP, TR-069 and XML provisioning, 3-way conferencing per port.
